name: CAT_ST_IDLE
meaning: update NORMAL; bucket contents seated each frame

name: CAT_ST_OPERATED
meaning: Wolf frozen at the catapult adjusting power (left/right); action exits

name: CAT_ST_THROW
meaning: arm swing + object along the LaunchArc; update ALWAYS; sound 0x107

name: CAT_ST_ARM_RETURN
meaning: arm returns to armAngle; then Wolf unfrozen, state 0

name: CAT_ST_LAUNCH_PENDING
meaning: one-update delay after Launch; relaunches and notifies Sam (msg 0x482)
